title: LLM Router: Rethinking Routing with Prefill Activations
abstract: arXiv:2603.20895v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Existing routers rely on semantic query features or handcrafted features, which often fail to capture model-specific failures or intrinsic task difficulty. We instead route using internal LLM activations, specifically the residual stream. Our key idea, Encoder-Target Decoupling, separates the model that produces the predictive signal (the Encoder) from the model whose correctness is being estimated (the Target), allowing open-weight encoders to predict the performance of closed-source target models. We evaluate layerwise geometric probes, finding that Fisher Separability ($J$) effectively identifies informative layers, supported by Effective Dimensionality ($d_{\mathrm{eff}}$) diagnostics. We then utilize a SharedTrunkNet, a joint multi-output MLP that predicts simultaneous correctness probabilities across candidate models using concatenated prefill features. In our experiments, SharedTrunkNet consistently outperforms semantic baseli

translated_title: LLM路由器：利用预填充激活重新思考路由
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2603.20895v3 公告类型：替换。现有路由器依赖语义查询特征或手工特征，这些往往无法捕捉模型特定失败或内在任务难度。我们转而使用内部LLM激活，特别是残差流，进行路由。我们的关键思想“编码器-目标解耦”将产生预测信号的模型（编码器）与估计正确性的模型（目标）分离，允许开放权重编码器预测闭源目标模型的性能。我们评估了逐层几何探针，发现Fisher可分性（$J$）能有效识别信息层，并得到有效维度（$d_{\mathrm{eff}}$）诊断的支持。然后，我们利用SharedTrunkNet，一个联合多输出MLP，通过拼接预填充特征来预测候选模型间的同步正确性概率。在我们的实验中，SharedTrunkNet持续优于语义基线。
tldr: 本文提出通过利用LLM内部残差流的预填充激活进行路由，并采用编码器-目标解耦和SharedTrunkNet架构，显著提升了对不同模型性能预测的准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes routing using prefill activations from LLM internal residual streams, with Encoder-Target Decoupling and SharedTrunkNet, significantly improving accuracy in predicting performance across candidate models.
